title: PHILOSOPHY - Feadship 44m
highlights: Feadship build, Studio De Voogt exterior
Counter-flow pool on the aft deck
Full repaint and systems service in spring 2024
description:
Crafted in the Netherlands, PHILOSOPHY is a 44.2-metre motor yacht built by Feadship in 2015, with exterior styling by Studio De Voogt and an interior by Bannenberg & Rowell that combines warmth and elegance.

She accommodates eight guests in four staterooms, with the two guest cabins convertible into a single VIP, and a crew of eight. The aft deck features a counter-flow pool, and Quantum stabilisers keep her steady underway and at anchor.

Twin Caterpillar C32 engines give a 12-knot cruise and a range of 3,850 nautical miles at 10 knots. She received a full repaint and complete servicing of all systems in spring 2024.
